title: Accuracy gating and approval flow for quant calibration artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Customers run calibration sweeps to produce quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) that become serving artifacts in Redwood Console. Today there is no standardized accuracy-gating workflow or human approval path before profiles are promoted to stable storage and used by traffic. This leads to accidental regressions, unclear ownership of artifacts, and challenges with retention + access control for high-value calibration runs.

Goal: Design and implement a calibrated artifact lifecycle that enforces an accuracy validation gate, captures reproducibility metadata, supports manual and automated approvals, and integrates with retention and ACLs so only authorized teams can promote and restore artifacts. The flow should be visible in Console run pages and expose hooks for CI and automated validators (unit tests / evaluation suites).

Scope: This ticket covers product requirements and acceptance criteria for the Console UI/workflow, policy definitions for promotion/archival, and the approval audit trail. Implementation work (runtime scheduling, artifact storage migration) will be tracked in ENG tickets referenced in dependencies.

Out-of-scope: Low-level kernel selection or quantization algorithm changes, and changes to model-serving runtime behavior beyond profile selection rules (handled in ENG).
acceptance_criteria: Calibration run page shows pass/fail status from automated accuracy validator with timestamp and evaluation suite version
Ability for a designated approver (per ACL role) to approve or reject a quantization artifact with a required comment
Promotion action writes an immutable approval record to the audit log and attaches user/role/PR links
Promoted artifacts inherit retention TTLs and a human-readable retention reason; Console allows manual override for archival with justification
Console exposes an API endpoint for CI to publish validation results and to request automatic promotion if gating passes
Access control prevents promotion/restore unless approver role is present and logs a permission check event
Rollback playbook documented that lists steps to revert a promotion and how to quarantine affected snapshots
